title: Yellowed Indulgent Spanish San Marzano Tomato Ensaимada
description: A bitter and springy Valencian dish featuring San Marzano tomatoes, this ensaimada is perfect for a special occasion, it is a sugar free friendly option
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the ensaimada dough to a large rectangle.
In a small bowl, mix together the olive oil, garlic, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture onto the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Top the dough with the San Marzano tomatoes and manchego cheese.
Fold the edges of the dough up over the filling to form a crust.
Place the ensaimada on the grill and cook for 20 minutes.
Rotate the ensaimada and cook for an additional 15 minutes.
Remove the ensaimada from the grill and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
